definitions.Orders: Distinct orders with status other than canceled/unavailable, by purchase date.
definitions.GMV: Sum of item price (freight excluded) over the orders counted as Orders. Not revenue or profit: commissions and costs are not in the data.
definitions.Average order value: GMV / orders that have at least one item.
definitions.Freight share: Sum of freight value / GMV, over the same orders.
definitions.On-time rate: Delivered orders with a delivery date, delivered on or before the estimated delivery date (day resolution) / such orders. Delivered orders only.
definitions.Average delivery time: Mean days from purchase date to delivery date, delivered orders only.
definitions.Average review score: Mean score of the most recent review per order (1-5). Only orders whose customer left a review; reviewers are self-selected.
definitions.Cancellation rate: Orders with status canceled / all orders purchased in the period.
definitions.Repeat rate (90d): Customers (customer_unique_id) with a second delivered order within 90 days of their first / customers whose first order is at least 90 days before the end of the data.
